tha-ap537:3.3: vicittakathikānaggaṁ → sasāvakaṁ cittakathikaṁ (sya-all) | vicittakathikānaggaṁ → S2 sāvakaṁ cittakathikaṁ. (pts note)

tha-ap537:18.1: tenānusiṭṭhā → tenānusiṭṭho (bj) | tenānusiṭṭho → tenānusiṭṭhā (bj: machasaṁ) | miga-y-ovādena → G. migayuvedhena. (pts note)
